items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I only knew him -- at this stage of the game I remember them by nicknames but not by their real names

ctx.x: Yeah, never knew his name, everybody called him Bonesky, all the musicians have nicknames. I only knew him -- at this stage of the game I remember them by nicknames but not by their real names, you know.
(Laughter) They called him Bogie because he wore a hat -- he wore it like Humphrey Bogart would, you know.
